selector.rationale: The radiographic findings of a well-encapsulated mass in the posterior mediastinum with moderate signal intensity on both T1-weighted and T2-weighted images support myelolipoma, and the lack of compressive symptoms or systemic complaints is consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.why: The radiographic findings were not typical for neurogenic tumors

rejected.why: While related to Refractory cytopenia with multilineage dysplasia, it is less specific

rejected.label: Mediastinal mass
rejected.why: Too general, as myelolipoma is a specific type of mediastinal mass
